data.name: Shobha
data.gender_notes: Shobha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root śubh, 'to shine, be beautiful' — śobhā, 'splendour'. Its root is Sanskrit śubh (शुभ्). A classical Sanskrit term for splendour. Shobha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Splendour; beauty; grace”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shobha expresses “Splendour; beauty; grace”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root śubh, 'to shine, be beautiful' — śobhā, 'splendour'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shobha total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
